resultArtifact.moduleRule: The module returns evidence to control and does not edit delivery evidence in its source worktrees.

startAuthority: start-token-issued.v1.json path, tokenId, sha256 and bytes
issued-manifest.v1.json path, manifestId, sha256 and bytes
migration-lease-activation.v1.json path, activationId, sha256 and bytes
repositories: repository, exact base branch/commit/tree and origin ref
module branch, upstream, result commit/tree and ordered result lineage
clean porcelain sha256, ahead/behind 0/0 and remoteExact true
contracts: Platform and Gateway OpenAPI raw-byte sha256 values from the start token
semantic seal and transport amendment raw-byte sha256 values

requiredPerRepository: touch-manifest compliance boolean and explicit outside-boundary file count
protectedPathAssertions: authorization, OpenAPI, generated PEP, generated route registry and Auth/Gateway changes equal zero
HrisProductMap and HRIS shell source changes equal zero
recovery and central control evidence changes equal zero

acceptanceResults.passRule: All twelve criteria must be PASS or an explicitly named PASS_AFTER_TARGETED_CORRECTION with the initial failing method and smallest rerun evidence. BLOCKED, SKIPPED or inferred coverage is not acceptance.

requiredPerCommand: test file count, test count, pass/fail/skip counts when emitted
log path, raw-byte SHA-256 and bytes
initial run or smallest failed-command rerun classification
testEvidence.rerunPolicy: Each full targeted stage runs at most once. After a fix, rerun only the failed command or smallest owning test and derive final acceptance from unaffected initial passes plus corrected method passes.

required: V327 exact path and raw-byte SHA-256
tenant/principal keys and RLS enabled plus forced assertions
no cross-service foreign key and no source payload assertion
migrationEvidence.runtimeDatabaseRule: If the required PostgreSQL migration checks cannot execute, report BLOCKED rather than PASS.

required: 98-node canonical count, 76+22 split and 98 unique route and label keys
authorized-subset response and current route/scope/field-policy reauthorization
tenant and principal isolation plus opaque receipt denial
generic /admin denial and absence of the five undeployed external targets
favorites and recents limits, CAS, idempotency, LRU, TTL and purge
shared receipt replay, digest mismatch and RESULT_UNKNOWN reconciliation
typed owner-evidence happy, missing, stale, mismatch, timeout and unavailable paths
PARTIAL projection on provider failure and no false empty success
minimized projection proving forbidden payload and sensitive fields are absent

requiredJourneys: favorite replace with success and 409 stale preference
recent record and exact destination open
in-progress item and RESULT_UNKNOWN receipt reconciliation
loading, authorized-empty, search-empty, 403, stale, partial and retryable-error states
requiredPerCapture: screenshot path, raw-byte SHA-256 and bytes
overflow, overlap, clipping, focus visibility and first-viewport review result

requiredFields: reviewed backend and frontend result commits
independentReview.admissionRule: P0 and P1 must both be zero before central result admission.

completionBoundary.requiredNonclaim: The module result is implementation evidence only; Work Explorer remains DRAFT/default OFF and central review and controlled dwp-dev integration are pending.

failureRules: Do not report PASS when required PostgreSQL, browser or accessibility evidence is unavailable.
Do not replace missing provider evidence with fixtures outside tests or with a false empty projection.
Do not absorb a central contract or owner-service change into the module result; stop and request an amendment.
Do not run or repeat a repository-wide suite to compensate for missing targeted evidence.
